1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the requests are specifically directed to filing proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include proof of claim forms and supporting documentation;
validating the data records prior to generating the bankruptcy documents; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations at periodic intervals of at least once per day.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the batch filing is performed by a server computer.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim, and wherein the requests are received using a secure file transfer protocol or via a Web site;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records by validating each data record, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and each proof of claim includes a proof of claim form and supporting documentation;
and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations at periodic intervals of at least once per day by a server computer.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the batch filing occurs at periodic intervals determined by the server computer.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors via email or website, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy and include filing status information.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol with encryption technology and authentication techniques.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site with secure authentication.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, wherein the aggregation includes generating and indexing combined claim data on a debtor-by-debtor basis.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report that includes aging information specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed;
enabling a user to request the report using a Web site; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site with secure authentication.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed, including status information for each proof of claim.

15. (Original) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer that aggregates and transmits the proofs of claims to the different bankruptcy organizations.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record prior to automatically generating the proofs of claims, wherein validation includes verifying the accuracy and completeness of creditor information and debtor information.
